شللنا (form I)
# شَلِلْنَا (šalilnā) /ʃa.lil.naː/: first-person plural past active of شَلَّ (šalla)

# شُلِلْنَا (šulilnā) /ʃu.lil.naː/: first-person plural past passive of شَلَّ (šalla) and شُلَّ (šulla)
